painted_surface_doctrine.definition: Wall painted surface = sum of (wall length × wall height) for all walls, minus area of openings (doors ~1.5m², windows ~0.5m² each). Ceiling painted surface = floor area of room. These are NOT equal to floor area.
painted_surface_doctrine.estimator_action: Receive floor_area from client. Apply conversion internally. Never present floor_area as painted_area in client-facing price.

floor_area_conversion_model.methodology: Assumes standard Moroccan residential layout. Room perimeter derived from floor area. Standard ceiling height 2.70m. Openings deducted: 1 door per room (1.5m²) + 1 window per room (0.5m²) for typical rooms; kitchen/bathroom 1 door only.
assumptions: Floor area to perimeter: perimeter ≈ 4 × sqrt(floor_area) for square rooms; real rooms vary ±15%
Window opening deduction: 0.5m² per standard window
Typical room count derived from apartment class
Balconies excluded from painted surface unless specified

scenarios.notes: Studio: 1 main room, kitchen alcove, bathroom. Bathroom painting often separate scope.
3 rooms (salon, chambre, cuisine) + circulation. 3 doors × 1.5 + 3 windows × 0.5.
4 rooms + couloir. 4 doors × 1.5 + 4 windows × 0.5 + 1 couloir door.
Villa: higher ceiling, more rooms, more openings. Requires site visit — QUOTE_REQUIRED for villa scope.

productivity.note: Assumes 2 coats per day for ready surfaces. Preparation reduces throughput. One painter working 8h.

painter_day_cost_candidates.note: Extrapolated from m² rates × productivity. A painter doing 60m²/day at 35 MAD/m² labour = 2100 MAD gross / day before commission and overhead — that is the gross billing rate. After FIXEO commission, artisan receives net.

commission_stress_test.note: High commission — artisan day net still above 350 MAD economy baseline

minimum_project_economic_basis.note: Even a 2-hour minimum job costs ~285 MAD in direct cost. 600 MAD minimum project adds reasonable margin. Below 600 MAD, the economics are unsustainable for the artisan.

calibration_candidates.label: Minimum Painting Project
calibration_candidates.research_anchor: EV-001 through EV-007 (Mano.ma). Economic analysis: 2h painter minimum + setup = ~285 MAD direct cost. 600 MAD minimum with reasonable margin.
scope_inclusions_candidate: Small retouche up to ~10m² painted surface
calibration_candidates.complexity_escape: If painted surface >10m², convert to PEIN-002 or PEIN-003 per-m² pricing
calibration_candidates.client_fairness_assessment: Transparent. Client knows minimum cost before booking. Prevents surprise when artisan charges full day for 2m² retouche.
calibration_candidates.artisan_fairness_assessment: Fair. Minimum covers setup cost. No artisan taking a 2h trip for 70 MAD.
calibration_candidates.worst_case_economics: At 600 MAD minimum: artisan net after 15% commission = 510 MAD for ~2h work. Acceptable.

calibration_candidates.label: Interior Wall — Labour Only (client supplies paint)
calibration_candidates.label_fr: Peinture mur intérieur — main d'œuvre seule
calibration_candidates.research_anchor: EV-001 (Mano.ma national 25–40 MO), EV-008 (Casablanca 35–50), EV-012 (Fès 22–36). HIGH confidence. Corroborated across 3+ sources.

ready_to_paint_contract.definition: Surface eligible for PEIN-002 base rate must be READY_TO_PAINT
included_at_no_extra_charge: Nail holes and screws (up to 5 per wall)
ready_to_paint_contract.objective_test: If artisan can start painting within 30 minutes of arrival (after protection setup), surface is READY_TO_PAINT. If prep time exceeds 30 min per wall, escape to PEIN-005.

coat_policy_detail.primer: Applied when substrate requires it (new plaster, colour change, high-absorption surface). Primer cost separate if not client-supplied.
coat_policy_detail.dark_to_light_escape: Dark colour → light colour change: 3 coats required. Artisan declares before starting. Price adjustment required — scope change.
coat_policy_detail.specialty_paint_escape: If client supplies paint requiring special technique (chalk paint, lime wash, etc.) — out of PEIN-002 standard scope. Quote required.

calibration_candidates.small_project_behaviour: Apply PEIN-001 minimum floor: FINAL_PRICE = max(800, painted_m2 × 35)
calibration_candidates.client_fairness_assessment: Excellent. Client controls paint quality and cost. Price is transparent per m². Measurement method must be explained clearly. No hidden material markup.
calibration_candidates.artisan_fairness_assessment: Good at 35 MAD/m². At 60m² ready walls per day: 35×60=2100 MAD/day gross. After 15% commission: 1785 MAD net/day. Sustainable.
calibration_candidates.worst_case_economics: Small job 20m² at 35 MAD = 700 MAD. Above minimum 800? No — 700 < 800, so PEIN-001 minimum applies: 800 MAD. Good.

calibration_candidates.label: Interior Wall — Labour + Standard Paint Included
calibration_candidates.label_fr: Peinture mur intérieur — main d'œuvre + peinture standard incluse
calibration_candidates.research_anchor: EV-002 (Mano.ma 60–100 all-in), EV-019 (Bnidari vinyl 25–40 all-in — economy tier), EV-020 (Bnidari satin 45–75), EV-022 (Bnidari platform 30–80). HIGH confidence.

paint_specification_candidate.finish: Mate or satiné au choix du client dans la gamme standard
paint_specification_candidate.colour: Client chooses from standard palette; mixing/tinting at artisan cost unless specialty colour
paint_specification_candidate.note: At standard paint consumption ~0.1L/m² per coat, 2 coats = 0.2L. Bidon 15L of Colorado at 439 MAD = 29 MAD/L retail. Material cost per m² ≈ 0.2 × 29 = 5.8 MAD retail. Artisan markup to 10–15 MAD/m² is reasonable.

calibration_candidates.coat_policy: Primer where required + 2 coats standard paint

model_A_client_supplied.pro: Transparent, no markup, client controls quality, simpler pricing
model_A_client_supplied.con: Client may buy wrong quantity, wrong product, cause delay

model_B_artisan_supplied_standard.con: Quality dispute risk, hidden markup risk

model_C_artisan_disclosed_cost.pro: Maximum transparency, client approves material cost before purchase
model_C_artisan_disclosed_cost.con: More complex pre-booking flow, artisan quotes material separately

paint_supply_model_comparison.recommendation_for_human: MODEL A (PEIN-002 CLIENT_SUPPLIED) is the most transparent FIXEO Fair Price architecture and should be the primary V1 offering. MODEL B (PEIN-003) serves clients who want full-service simplicity. MODEL C could be a future upgrade flow. Recommend offering both PEIN-002 and PEIN-003 as distinct service options.

material_economics_analysis.note: At 60 MAD/m² all-in, gross margin before commission is ~16%. After 15% FIXEO commission: artisan net on material+labour ≈ 51-15% = 43.4 MAD/m². Covers material (15.2) + labour (35) = 50.2 cost. Tight but viable at this efficiency.

calibration_candidates.client_fairness_assessment: Good if paint specification is explicit. Risk: client disputes paint brand or quality. Mitigation: name the brand class in booking confirmation.
calibration_candidates.artisan_fairness_assessment: Fair if material allowance is built in. Risk: artisan uses cheap paint to increase margin. Mitigation: require named brand class.
calibration_candidates.worst_case_economics: If artisan uses cheapest paint (5.8 MAD/m²) and bills 60 MAD: gross 54.2 margin before commission. At 15%: net 51 MAD/m² − 15.2 material = 35.8 MAD/m² effective labour. Same as PEIN-002 35 MAD/m² labour + minor material gain. Sustainable.

calibration_candidates.label: Ceiling — Standard Repaint
calibration_candidates.research_anchor: EV-005 (Mano.ma MO only 20–35 DH/m² — minimal scope). EV-015 (Mano.ma ceiling guide MO only 40–80 — broader scope including enduit). EV-016 (all-in 60–150). EV-026 (Mondevis.ma 2015: 20–32 DH — updated estimate +40% = 28–45 DH 2026).
calibration_candidates.evidence_conflict_resolution: The ambiguity (20–35 vs 40–80) resolves based on SCOPE: a minimal ready ceiling with no enduit = 20–35 MO. The professional standard in Morocco (because most béton brut ceilings require enduit lissage) = 40–80 MO. FIXEO must define which ceiling contract it standardizes.

contract_A_ready_ceiling.label: READY_CEILING — sound surface, no enduit required
contract_A_ready_ceiling.eligibility: Ceiling is plastered/painted, stable, no major stains, no enduit required
contract_A_ready_ceiling.scope: Minor sanding, primer where needed, 2 coats white/light paint
contract_A_ready_ceiling.measurement_basis: PAINTED_SURFACE_M2 = ceiling area = room floor area

contract_B_with_minor_prep.label: CEILING_WITH_MINOR_PREP — standard Moroccan béton ceiling
contract_B_with_minor_prep.eligibility: Standard Moroccan béton brut ceiling requiring local enduit lissage
contract_B_with_minor_prep.scope: Local enduit lissage, sanding, primer, 2 coats standard paint

calibration_candidates.recommended_v1_contract: CONTRACT_B (with minor prep all-in) is more honest for the Moroccan context. CONTRACT_A could exist as a secondary service for repaint of already-finished ceilings.
calibration_candidates.reason: Ceiling requires more physical effort (overhead posture), often enduit lissage, and may use different paint finish (usually mate/white). Separate rate is justified.
calibration_candidates.client_fairness_assessment: Good if scope (enduit included or not) is explicit at booking.
calibration_candidates.artisan_fairness_assessment: Fair. Ceiling work is physically harder. 45 MAD/m² all-in at 50m²/day = 2250 MAD/day gross. After commission = 1912 MAD net. Sustainable.
calibration_candidates.worst_case_economics: 20m² ceiling at 45 MAD = 900 MAD. Above 800 MAD minimum → OK, no minimum applies. Good.

calibration_candidates.label: Interior Wall — Labour + Minor Preparation
calibration_candidates.label_fr: Peinture mur intérieur avec préparation légère
calibration_candidates.research_anchor: Derived: PEIN-003 base (45–80 DH all-in) + EV-032 enduit supplement (20–40 DH) = 65–120. EV-007 primer surcharge (8–15). Mano.ma rebouchage supplement +5–15 DH/m².

included: Rebouchage of holes up to 3cm diameter
Local filler on cracks up to 3mm width
Local enduit on up to 20% of wall surface
excluded_escape_to_quote: More than 20% of surface requires enduit
Cracks requiring V-cut and structural filler
Peeling over more than 25% of surface

calibration_candidates.client_fairness_assessment: Good if minor preparation boundaries are explicitly stated. Client must understand what triggers an escape to quote.
calibration_candidates.artisan_fairness_assessment: Fair. 45 MAD/m² labour at 40m²/day (slower due to prep) = 1800 MAD/day gross. Sustainable.
calibration_candidates.worst_case_economics: 15m² at 75 MAD/m² all-in = 1125 MAD. Above 800 MAD minimum. OK.

calibration_candidates.label: Full Standard Room (walls + ceiling)
calibration_candidates.research_anchor: Derived from per-m² rates × standard room painted surface. Reddit EV-029: 17,000 DH / ~5 rooms = 3,400 MAD/room premium. FIXEO pSEO T0 comparison: chambre 800–1500 (LEGACY_LOW to LEGACY_SUPPORTED). Standard market cross-check: 25m² room, 65m² painted walls + 25m² ceiling = 90m² total. At 55 MAD/m² all-in: 4,950 MAD. This exceeds range suggesting the 1,200–2,800 range is for smaller rooms or excludes ceiling.

A_FIXED_PER_ROOM.cons: Hides surface area variance — 15m² vs 25m² room would get same price

B_CONDITIONAL_FIXED.pros: Transparent — room must meet size criteria
B_CONDITIONAL_FIXED.cons: Requires client to know floor area

C_ESTIMATED_M2_BASED.pros: Most accurate — calculated from room dimensions

calibration_candidates.recommended_architecture: CONDITIONAL_FIXED — room must be 15–25m² floor area. If larger, convert to per-m² pricing.
calibration_candidates.client_fairness_assessment: Good for standard rooms. Risk: client has unusually large room and expects same price. Mitigation: define room size range at booking.
calibration_candidates.artisan_fairness_assessment: At 1,800 MAD for ~75m² painted surface = 24 MAD/m². At 60m²/day, this is ~1.25 painter-days. Gross per day = 1440 MAD. After 15% commission = 1224 MAD/day. Tight — room package may need to be calibrated higher.
calibration_candidates.worst_case_economics: If artisan takes 1.5 days (slower prep, occupied), 1800 MAD / 1.5 = 1200 MAD/day gross. After commission: 1020 MAD/day. Still viable but at low end.

calibration_candidates.label: Enduit de Lissage — Preparation Only
calibration_candidates.research_anchor: EV-032 (Mano.ma: 20–40 DH/m² supplement for enduit). EV-017 (Mano.ma ceiling delta: all-in with enduit 80–180 vs without 60–150 → delta 20–30 DH/m²). SRC-009 (Mondevis.ma real devis context).

labour_vs_material_resolution.market_ambiguity: Some sources bundle enduit material into the rate; others show labour only.
labour_vs_material_resolution.recommendation: LABOUR + ENDUIT MATERIAL INCLUDED in standard rate. Enduit material (poudre à enduire / enduit de lissage) costs ~3–6 MAD/m² retail. Including it in the rate at 25–30 MAD/m² is transparent and operationally simple.

includes: Surface left smooth and ready for primer/paint
scope_definition.escape: If substrate requires >5mm fill or structural repair → HORS PÉRIMÈTRE Maçonnerie

calibration_candidates.client_fairness_assessment: High transparency as an explicit add-on service. Client understands what they are paying for.
calibration_candidates.artisan_fairness_assessment: At 25 MAD/m² and 35m²/day productivity = 875 MAD/day gross enduit only. After 15% commission: 744 MAD. Low day rate — enduit is typically bundled into painting, not standalone. As add-on it makes sense.
calibration_candidates.worst_case_economics: 20m² enduit at 25 MAD = 500 MAD. Below 800 MAD minimum → minimum applies. Should be bundled with painting service in most cases.

deferred_services.label: Full Apartment Repaint Package
deferred_services.reason: Insufficient evidence to standardize. Range too wide (5,000–16,000 MAD). Apartment size, condition, and paint quality variation too great. Recommend DEFERRED pending field validation data.

deferred_services.label: Interior Door Painting
deferred_services.reason: LOW confidence evidence. No strong Moroccan source. DEFERRED to V2.

deferred_services.label: Decorative — Tadelakt / Stucco / Béton Ciré
deferred_services.reason: Artisan skill-dependent. 80–600 DH/m² range is too wide to standardize. QUOTE_REQUIRED always.

deferred_services.label: Exterior Facade
deferred_services.reason: Scaffolding variable, height, surface condition unknown. QUOTE_REQUIRED.

deferred_services.label: Heavy Wall Repair / Moisture
deferred_services.reason: QUOTE_REQUIRED or HORS PÉRIMÈTRE depending on diagnosis.

small_project_simulations.note: Below minimum threshold — minimum project applies at 800 MAD.
Labour only still below minimum. All-in exceeds minimum — per-m² applies.
Labour only: minimum still governs at 800. All-in: per-m² governs.
First m² tier where labour-only exceeds minimum. Per-m² governs.

apartment_simulations_calibrated.external_market_check: Mano.ma simulation for 50m² painted surface: 3,000–4,500 MAD all-in economy. Our studio (105m²) is larger scope — market check confirms range.
Phase 7B.9 simulation for F2: MO only 4,125–8,250 / all-in 7,425–13,200. Our calibrated numbers: 8,055 MO / 11,880 all-in. ALIGNED.
Phase 7B.9: F3 MO only 5,500–11,000 / all-in 9,900–17,600. Calibrated: 10,740 MO / 15,840 all-in. ALIGNED upper-mid range.
Phase 7B.9: F4 MO only 7,500–15,000 / all-in 13,500–24,000. Calibrated: 14,313 MO / 21,000 all-in. ALIGNED.

apartment_simulations_calibrated.note: Villa at this scale is QUOTE_REQUIRED. Figures shown for reference calibration check only.

occupied_vs_empty_policy.recommendation: EMPTY_PROPERTY = standard eligible at standard rates. OCCUPIED_PROPERTY = conditional — acceptable if light furniture, with standard scope. Escape to quote if: heavy furniture requiring multiple moves, restricted room access, room-by-room staging required, animals, children.
occupied_vs_empty_policy.note: No percentage surcharge approved. Occupied-property complexity should be handled via scope qualification at booking.

moisture_mold_doctrine.rule: FIXEO must not create a service that enables artisans to paint over unresolved water damage.
escape_workflow: Client mentions humidity / recurring mold / peeling caused by moisture
ROUTE to: Plomberie (pipe), Toiture (roof infiltration), Maçonnerie (structural moisture)
CONFIRM wall dry for minimum 2 weeks
moisture_mold_doctrine.anti_humidity_paint_policy: Anti-humidity paint (Coloflex, anti-salpêtre) is valid ONLY on surfaces with confirmed-resolved moisture source, as a preventive measure. NOT valid as primary treatment for active water infiltration.

client_prescreening_questions: What surface(s) do you want to paint? (walls / ceiling / both / doors)
Floor area of the space(s) in m² (approximate is fine)
Current wall condition: Good (clean, stable) / Minor damage (small holes, fine cracks) / Major damage (peeling, large cracks)
Any humidity stains, mold, or recurring peeling?
Same colour or colour change? If colour change: dark to light?
Do you already have paint purchased?
Paint quality preference: Economy / Standard washable / Premium
If occupied: light furniture, or heavy / difficult to move?
